title: PTools 5.67.x function duplication audit
note: Baseline audit and decision ledger; this file is not release proof. / Auditoría base y registro de decisiones; no es una prueba de lanzamiento. / 基线审计和决策台账；不能作为发布通过证明。

entries.evidence: 289 consecutive lines are maintained in both source locations; Base is conditionally excluded by POOTOOLS_SPLIT_UIFOUNDATION.
entries.decision: Keep UIFoundation as the implementation owner; prove SPM/Pods symbol parity before making Base a thin compatibility adapter.
entries.migrationRisk: Public helper visibility and CocoaPods flattened compilation may change.
entries.blockedReason: No consumer/API parity build has been recorded for the adapter change.
entries.reproduction: Compare exported helper symbols and compile legacy Base consumers in both distributions.

entries.primaryEntry: PToolsTransferCore contract plus a future transfer execution owner
entries.evidence: Network, Transfer, audio, video and Live Photo paths have different request, progress, retry and cancellation semantics.
entries.confirmedOwner: PToolsTransferCore/PToolsTransfer after behavior parity is proven
entries.decision: Collect a behavior matrix first; migrate one adapter at a time and preserve per-subscriber cancellation.
entries.migrationRisk: Authentication, destination identity, resume data and cancellation could regress.
entries.blockedReason: Transfer currently lacks several Network capabilities and is not yet an equivalent executor.
entries.reproduction: Run the matrix for headers, destination, retry, duplicate subscribers, pause/resume, background and HTTP status handling.

entries.evidence: Both views independently maintain data, selection, measurement, image and badge behavior.
entries.decision: Map the legacy model to the new stable-ID core only after all legacy visual and callback semantics are covered.
entries.migrationRisk: Legacy width rules, badge placement and callback timing are not one-to-one mappings.
entries.blockedReason: The current PTMainSegmentDataSource does not cover every legacy property.
entries.reproduction: Compare legacy and new selection, reload, badge, image, RTL and dynamic type behavior.

entries.evidence: PTSpeech and OSSSpeech independently own recognizers, recognition requests and tasks; OSSSpeech also owns recording and TTS.
entries.confirmedOwner: Speech recognition session core; OSSSpeech remains the recording/TTS adapter
entries.decision: Share recognition lifecycle only; preserve recording, TTS, waveform and delegate compatibility.
entries.migrationRisk: Audio session, interruption, partial/final results and delegate timing can change.
entries.blockedReason: No real-device speech lifecycle regression evidence exists.
entries.reproduction: Exercise authorization, start/stop, interruption, background, cancellation and partial/final result ordering.

entries.evidence: Export status, temporary output and completion lifecycles overlap, while composition, filter and reader/writer pipelines differ.
entries.decision: Share output preparation, progress, cancellation, cleanup and completion-once; keep render/composition builders separate.
entries.migrationRisk: Filter compositor, transform, audio and Reader/Writer semantics could be lost.
entries.blockedReason: The pipelines are not behaviorally equivalent and need separate regression fixtures.
entries.reproduction: Run ordinary, C7 filter, VideoEditor filter, cancellation, timeout and output cleanup scenarios.

entries.primaryEntry: PTOverlayCore for host, scene and lifecycle responsibilities
entries.evidence: Overlay Core already owns Scene/Window/registry lifecycle, while HUD visual and progress semantics remain separate.
entries.confirmedOwner: PTOverlayCore for container lifecycle; each visual HUD remains an adapter
entries.decision: Do not merge visual components; migrate host/lifecycle responsibilities one consumer at a time.
entries.migrationRisk: Modal, progress, media cancellation and custom content semantics differ.
entries.blockedReason: PTProgressHUD has no established production consumer parity with PTHudView.
entries.reproduction: Verify Network, CheckUpdate, VideoEditor, C7 and multi-Scene show/hide behavior.

entries.primaryEntry: PTMediaCache policy for media data, with decoded-image and file-cache adapters
entries.evidence: Thumbnail data partially uses PTMediaCache, while audio/video files retain independent directories, TTL and metrics rules.
entries.confirmedOwner: PTMediaCache policy contract; storage layers remain explicit
entries.decision: Unify key, TTL, quota, low-disk and metrics contracts without merging UIImage, Data and file layers.
entries.migrationRisk: Changing keys or directories could invalidate caches or cause duplicate downloads.
entries.blockedReason: Current cache governance and implementation metrics do not yet agree.
entries.reproduction: Verify cold/hot cache, TTL, memory warning, low disk, key variants and metrics.

entries.primaryEntry: PTContentState priority model with UI adapters
entries.evidence: Multiple views render loading, skeleton, error, empty and content states through different entry points.
entries.decision: Unify priority and idempotent transitions; retain visual adapters until behavior parity is measured.
entries.migrationRisk: Skeleton/empty layering can hide content or change existing callbacks.
entries.blockedReason: No complete state transition regression matrix is recorded.
entries.reproduction: Repeat loading, skeleton, error, empty and content transitions during reload and cancellation.

entries.primaryEntry: Separate generation/render/preview/document contracts with shared scaling/cache helpers
entries.evidence: The modules share output/scaling concerns but have distinct document and preview responsibilities.
entries.confirmedOwner: PDF shared utility layer (candidate; not selected for destructive merge)
entries.decision: Do not merge public roles; audit common scaling, cache and output helpers only.
entries.migrationRisk: Changing page bounds, renderer behavior or document access can alter exported files.
entries.blockedReason: No file-output golden fixtures are recorded.
entries.reproduction: Compare generated page sizes, scale, preview and multi-page output before any helper move.

entries.primaryEntry: PToolsPermissionCore Foundation contract plus PermissionCore compatibility facade
entries.evidence: SPM and CocoaPods conditions expose different PTPermission declarations and request/settings contracts.
entries.decision: Use PToolsPermissionCore as the single Foundation contract; keep PermissionCore as the compatibility facade and use CocoaPods aggregate embedding instead of importing a nonexistent subspec module.
entries.migrationRisk: Runtime permission status mapping and exactly-once completion still need device/API regression coverage.
entries.blockedReason: Runtime parity has not been proven for all permission kinds on physical devices.
entries.reproduction: Verify Photos limited, Notifications provisional, Bluetooth, Face ID, Location and exactly-once completion.

entries.evidence: The legacy logging entry already forwards to PTLogger under compatibility conditions.
entries.decision: Not a pending duplicate merge; retain and guard the existing facade.
entries.migrationRisk: Fallback compilation or release redaction could regress if the facade is removed.
entries.blockedReason: Existing forwarding is the intended compatibility boundary.
entries.reproduction: Verify debug/release redaction and import visibility in both distributions.

entries.evidence: Legacy entry points already dispatch through PTFeedbackCenter.
entries.decision: No merge; maintain event and policy guard.
entries.migrationRisk: Removing old category symbols would break public consumers.
entries.blockedReason: This is an existing facade, not two independent execution owners.
entries.reproduction: Verify installAsDefault and style mapping on supported platforms.

entries.evidence: Socket manager already delegates to the WebSocket client; SSE and WebSocket remain distinct protocols.
entries.decision: Guard the existing facade and preserve protocol-specific realtime behavior.
entries.migrationRisk: Conflating SSE and WebSocket would change reconnect and event semantics.
entries.blockedReason: Existing delegation is intentional and protocol boundaries are different.
entries.reproduction: Verify connect, reconnect, cancellation and SSE/WebSocket separation.

entries.decision: Keep the old type as a compatibility subclass and add a regression guard.
entries.migrationRisk: Deleting the old type would break existing source compatibility.
entries.blockedReason: The inheritance relationship already removes the duplicate execution owner.
entries.reproduction: Verify legacy initializer and event behavior against PTBannerView.

entries.evidence: The search controller composes the search bar; they do not implement two independent search controllers.
entries.decision: Do not merge; guard the search bar height and clear-button behavior separately.
entries.migrationRisk: Flattening the composition would reduce customization and break public types.
entries.blockedReason: The apparent duplication is a normal controller/view composition.
entries.reproduction: Verify typed text, clear button, reload and configurable search bar height.

entries.primaryEntry: To be selected after call-graph and behavior audit
entries.evidence: Names and responsibilities suggest possible overlap, but no sufficient behavior-level proof has been collected.
entries.decision: Do not merge speculatively; collect callers, public symbols and runtime contracts first.
entries.migrationRisk: High: these are high-frequency public UI and image entry points.
entries.blockedReason: Insufficient evidence for a safe single-source decision.
entries.reproduction: Generate caller matrix and compare public signatures, lifecycle and platform availability.
